---
title: "Cause-of-death code list"
format: html
---

Builds the list of every cause-of-death code that appears on the ICF deaths, with a description for each one. `04-sentinel-lookup.r` reads this list and adds the sentinel levels.

Neither the NCHS list nor the ICD-10 list covers all of the codes on our deaths, so this combines them. It uses the ICD-10 description when there is one and the NCHS description otherwise. The ICD-10 file also supplies the group each code falls under (`master_code`, `master_desc`).

This replaces the earlier route through `archive/cod-nhcs-icd10-codes.qmd`, `archive/separate-causes-of-death.r` and the `all_code_list` tab of the Google Sheet.

```{r}
#| label: setup

pacman::p_load(tidyverse, readxl, here)

i_am("death-certificates/03-cause-code-list.qmd")

```

Every code on the ICF deaths, with the number of times it appears.

```{r}
#| label: icf-codes

icf_codes <-
  readRDS(here("death-certificates/processed/02-icf-deaths.RDS")) |>
  select ( death_id, rac) |>
  separate_rows ( rac, sep = "\\s+") |>
  count ( rac)

```

## NCHS list

The NCHS list of valid cause-of-death codes, downloaded from CDC. The codes have periods in them, so take those out to match the death certificates.

```{r}
#| label: nchs-codes

nchs_codes <-
  read_excel(here("death-certificates/data/cod-codes/allvalid2023-detailed-titles-headings.xlsx"), skip = 5) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate ( code = str_remove_all ( code, "\\.")) |>
  select ( code, nchs_desc = icd_title)

```

## ICD-10 list from CMS

Downloaded the 2025 files from https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coding-billing/icd-10-codes

The "order file" has header rows that group the codes in the order they appear in the instructions. Even when a code has no exact match, its group is often good enough for us.

```{r}
#| label: icd10-codes

icd10_codes <-
  read_fwf ( here("death-certificates/data/cod-codes/icd10cm_order_2025.txt"),
    fwf_cols ( row_order = c(1, 5),
               code = c(7, 13),
               header = c(15, 15),
               short_desc = c(17, 76),
               long_desc = c(78, NA)
    ),
    col_types = cols("i", "c", "i", "c", "c")
  ) |>
  mutate ( headline = if_else ( header == 0, short_desc, NA_character_),
           master_code = if_else ( header == 0, code, NA_character_)
  ) |>
  fill ( c ( headline, master_code), .direction = "down") |>
  select ( code, icd_desc = short_desc, master_code, master_desc = headline)

```

## Combine

Keep only the codes on our deaths.

```{r}
#| label: combine

cause_code_list <-
  nchs_codes |>
  full_join ( icd10_codes, join_by ( code)) |>
  inner_join ( icf_codes, join_by ( code == rac)) |>
  mutate ( description = coalesce ( icd_desc, nchs_desc)) |>
  select ( code, description, master_code, master_desc, n) |>
  arrange ( code)

```

Codes on the deaths that are in neither list. These would end up with no description, so this should come back empty.

```{r}
#| label: check-unmatched

icf_codes |>
  anti_join ( cause_code_list, join_by ( rac == code))

```

```{r}
#| label: save

saveRDS(cause_code_list, here("death-certificates/processed/03-cause-code-list.RDS"))

```
